shared_elements: decorative border framing the figural field
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures wearing belted, patterned garments rendered in relief and both enclose the figural field within a decorative border, but these are generic conventions. A shows a horizontal procession of profile figures leading a camel past a tree in a long register, while B shows a compact, near-frontal seated/crouching figure group enclosed in a circular openwork frame of leaf-like forms — different compositional schemes and no shared specific motif.
